title: Add Hierarchy & Direction to Habits Table
description: Create database migration (26.sql) to extend the Habits table with two new columns: (1) 'parent_id' integer nullable column with foreign key reference to Habits(id) for hierarchical parent-child relationships - enables grouping habits under parent routines; (2) 'direction' integer column with default value 0 (POSITIVE) to support habit tracking direction (POSITIVE=0 for 'things to do', NEGATIVE=1 for 'things to avoid'). Includes index on parent_id for efficient hierarchy queries and index on direction for filtering. This single migration combines both hierarchical structure and direction tracking, avoiding multiple migrations to the same table. Note: This supersedes the separate 'habit-direction-database' ticket which would have created a redundant migration.
